summary: The existing local public registry preparation composes complete public Atlas seed synchronization, registry-derived projections, exact generator-owned organization projection retirement, both skill manifests, own registry rows and affected-output recheck. The maintained generator owns a closed twelve-target retirement roster; it removes only well-formed retired organization regions, refuses extra raw, inline, padded, duplicate, partial, reversed or overlapping markers before changing any retired target, and treats already absent regions as an unchanged repeat. Product and shared Protocol facts and their active projections retain their original semantics. Explicit local-preparation performs structural retirement without inventing engine facts; default full generation/check still requires genuine current engine emission and checks committed outputs. Source guards and existing caller controls now distinguish prepared current organization consumers from separately qualified product behavior instead of requiring retired organization V1 ledger/routing prose. Both driver and coordination-Kit skill inventories/digests and only own registry rows reconcile from canonical sources; no foreign producer rows, materialization predicates or private inputs change. Preparation remains explicitly not full Protocol/CLR qualification, remote producer coherence, publication or installed adoption. Original missing-tool and source-review failures remain failures; inert controls establish no native qualification or comparative savings.
title: Prepare registry digests after canonical organization projection retirement
